_help: Sources checked by: python job_hunter.py run
csv/json = local files (path relative to this folder). No filter unless you add one.
greenhouse/lever = official public job-board APIs. 'board' is the slug in the company's
Network sources default to filter {title_any: profile, location_any: profile}, drop senior/lead/manager titles,
and are never checked more often than min_interval_minutes (hard floor 10).
Do not add LinkedIn/Indeed or any site without an official public API.

sources.name: my_jobs
sources._note: Paste jobs you find by hand into my_jobs.csv (same columns as sample_jobs.csv), then set enabled true.
